title: Smoking Gun Signatures of Quasilocal Probability in Black Hole Ringdowns
summary: Building on recent work introducing the idea of Quasilocal Probability in curved spacetime, we develop its observational implications for black hole ringdown in detail. We show that horizon-induced probability flux leads to an effective non-Hermitian dynamics producing three distinctive signatures, which are correlated multi-mode deviations, weak amplitude dependence and a mismatch between waveform damping and energy accounting. These effects arise from a single boundary-flux mechanism and therefore exhibit a constrained, low-dimensional structure not expected in generic modified gravity…
